key_phrases: CapEx expected to be higher than FY2004
demand remains higher than our available capacity
Copilot customers increased more than 60% quarter-over-quarter
analysis.reasoning: The call is overwhelmingly positive, driven by massive growth in AI-related segments (Azure AI, Copilot). Management shows high confidence and provides extremely specific quantitative data to support their claims of market share gains. While there is a clear signal of aggressive capital expenditure expansion to meet demand, they also transparently addressed the risks of capacity constraints and the margin pressure resulting from scaling AI infrastructure. The QA session was highly direct, with management providing detailed explanations for CapEx timing and Azure growth fluctuations.
